claims.title: IEEE-CIS Card Fraud Federated Learning PR-AUC
claims.dataset_scale: 590,540 Real Kaggle/Vesta transactions (80/20 chronological holdout, 4,064 test fraud)
claims.metric_definition: sklearn.metrics.average_precision_score (reported as PR-AUC in project tables)
claims.mandatory_caveat: Transaction data are real competition data from Kaggle/Vesta (590k txns); 3 clients are simulated partitions under Dirichlet alpha=0.5. Evaluates standard FedAvg on a public dataset; does not represent a live multi-bank institutional deployment.
claims.notes: Empirically measured from 590,540 real IEEE-CIS transactions (434 merged columns, 421 numeric model inputs) under strict chronological out-of-time 80/20 holdout across 3 simulated bank clients (Dirichlet alpha=0.5 non-IID label skew) across seeds [42, 123, 456]. Centralized baseline AP: 0.439861; FedAvg AP: 0.389172; Paired Delta: -0.050689. Client heterogeneity is one plausible contributor to the observed gap. The predefined engineering target of 0.8120 was not reached under the evaluated chronological holdout; temporal distribution shift is a plausible contributor, but this experiment did not isolate its causal effect. Historical synthetic smoke metrics (0.7811 / 0.7554) came from an earlier synthetic fallback experiment and are non-comparable.

legacy_artifact.status: ARCHIVED -- synthetic fallback data produced when processed dataset was absent

claims.title: IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection Recall @ 0.1% FPR
claims.dataset_scale: 590,540 Real Kaggle/Vesta transactions (80/20 chronological holdout, 4,064 test fraud, 114,044 test legit)
claims.metric_definition: Recall at target FPR = 0.001 (0.1% FPR) evaluated as a test-set diagnostic operating point
claims.mandatory_caveat: Operating point is a diagnostic threshold computed on held-out test data (~114 false positives, ~803 true positives, ~917 total alerts); not a validated production deployment threshold. Transaction data are real; bank federation is simulated.
claims.notes: Empirically measured test-set diagnostic operating point at 0.1% FPR (4,064 positive support, 114,044 negative support). Centralized baseline recall: 20.04% +/- 0.32%; FedAvg recall: 19.76% +/- 1.41%. False-positive budget is approximately 114 false positives, capturing ~803 true positives (~917 total investigation alerts). The predefined engineering target of 58.90% was not reached under the evaluated chronological holdout; temporal distribution shift is a plausible contributor, but this experiment did not isolate its causal effect. Historical synthetic smoke metrics are archived as non-comparable.

claims.dataset_scale: 20k Transactions, Centralized / Bank-Node Partition
claims.notes: Genuine DP-SGD (PyTorch Opacus PrivacyEngine, accountant='prv') with per-sample clipping C=1.0 and Gaussian mechanism over 20,000 synthetic transactions (15 features, 2.1% fraud prevalence, 84 test fraud cases). claims.title: Single-Worker Localhost HTTP Benchmark Peak Throughput (Class B1 v2 - aiohttp Load Generator)
claims.dataset_scale: C=50 Concurrent Clients (Peak Empirical Throughput; 3000 Requests across 3 reps)
claims.notes: Class B1 v2 Single-Worker Localhost HTTP Benchmark over local loopback TCP socket (127.0.0.1:8089/api/v1/score-transaction) served by Uvicorn (single-worker) using a separate-process aiohttp load generator under benchmark mode (rate limiting disabled to isolate pure inference capacity). Target applies strictly to successful HTTP 2xx inference transactions. Peak throughput reached 543.0 ± 23.6 successful 2xx req/s at C=50 across 3 independent repetitions (3,000 requests, 100% 2xx success, pooled p50=89.02ms, pooled p99=156.81ms). Following the complete pure-ASGI conversion of all middleware (active custom BaseHTTPMiddleware depth = 0), successful throughput across tiers: C=1: 134.9 ± 2.4 req/s (pooled p50=7.12ms, p99=10.85ms); C=10: 452.8 ± 14.0 req/s (pooled p50=20.48ms, p99=39.96ms); C=50: 543.0 ± 23.6 req/s (pooled p50=89.02ms, p99=156.81ms); C=100: 520.8 ± 37.6 req/s (pooled p50=178.50ms, p99=289.42ms); C=250: 431.9 ± 29.6 req/s (pooled p50=474.97ms, p99=950.14ms); C=500: 401.7 ± 26.7 req/s (pooled p50=1060.89ms, pooled p99=1760.77ms). Historical baselines: Pre-intervention (89.0 req/s peak) in latency_http_service_benchmark_pre_intervention.json; Post-APIVersion (233.7 req/s peak) in latency_http_service_benchmark_post_apiversion.json; Post-W3C (327.9 req/s peak) in latency_http_service_benchmark_post_w3c.json; Post-MTLS (369.0 req/s peak) in latency_http_service_benchmark.json; HTTPX measurements (191.0 req/s at C=10 collapsing to 41.6 req/s at C=500 due to client event-loop starvation) in latency_http_service_benchmark_httpx.json.

pre_intervention_baseline.notes: Pre-intervention synchronous FeatureStore execution on event loop yielded 89.0 req/s peak at C=10.

post_apiversion_baseline.notes: Post-APIVersion pure-ASGI state (BaseHTTP depth 4) yielded 233.7 req/s peak at C=10 and 174.4 req/s at C=500.

post_w3c_baseline.notes: Post-W3C pure-ASGI state (BaseHTTP depth 3) yielded 327.9 req/s peak at C=10 and 231.8 req/s at C=500.

post_mtls_baseline.notes: Post-MTLS pure-ASGI state (BaseHTTP depth 2) yielded 369.0 req/s peak at C=10 and 277.6 req/s at C=500.

claims.title: Byzantine Robustness: Severe Seed-Level Non-IID Instability Observations (Canonical)
claims.dataset_scale: 284,807 rows, 12 simulated clients, Dirichlet alpha=0.5, 2 Byzantine nodes
claims.mandatory_caveat: Mandatory disclosure: Multi-seed evaluation revealed catastrophic seed-level collapses that three-seed means would otherwise conceal. Single Krum collapsed to PR-AUC 0.0011 on Seed 456 under Sign-Flip; FedAvg collapsed to 0.1653 on Seed 42 under Sign-Flip; Coordinate Median collapsed to 0.2045 and Bulyan to 0.2220 on Seed 123 under ALIE. Root cause for Single Krum Seed 456 collapse is ROOT_CAUSE_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_FROM_CANONICAL_ARTIFACT due to unrecorded client selection traces.
claims.notes: Demonstrates that single-seed Byzantine benchmarks are scientifically invalid and multi-seed reporting is required.
